pages.text: The $(l)Alchemy System$() is a core life skill. Through alchemy, you can craft various pills for spiritual power recovery, cultivation acceleration, breakthrough assistance, and healing.

pages.title: Alchemy Workstations
pages.text: Alchemy requires dedicated $(l)Alchemy Furnaces$() or $(l)workstations$().$(br2)Basic process:$(li)Build or place alchemy furnace$(li)Prepare recipe materials (herbs, beast materials, minerals)$(li)Place materials per recipe$(li)Provide spiritual power or fire source$(li)Wait for completion$(br2)Workstation operation state determines efficiency and success rate. See $(l)Station Operations$().

pages.title: Pill Quality
pages.text: Pills have four quality tiers:$(li)$(l)Low Grade$(): Base effect, high success rate$(li)$(l)Middle Grade$(): 1.5x effect$(li)$(l)High Grade$(): 2x effect$(li)$(l)Perfect Grade$(): 3x effect, very rare$(br2)Alchemy skill level, workstation configuration, and material quality all affect final pill quality.

pages.title: Basic Pills
pages.text: Beginner-recommended pills:$(li)$(l)Rejuvenation Pill$(): Restores spiritual power, Qi Refining essential$(li)$(l)Foundation Building Pill$(): Aids Foundation breakthrough$(li)$(l)Healing Pill$(): Restores health$(li)$(l)Clear Spirit Powder$(): Removes debuffs$(li)$(l)Fasting Pill$(): Removes hunger, essential for long meditation$(br2)Simple recipes, easy materials, good for skill practice.

pages.title: Advanced Pills
pages.text: High-tier pills require rare materials and high alchemy skill:$(li)$(l)Core Formation Pill$(): Aids Core Formation breakthrough$(li)$(l)Nascent Soul Pill$(): Aids Nascent Soul breakthrough$(li)$(l)Deity Transformation Pill$(): Aids Deity breakthrough$(li)$(l)Cultivation Pill$(): Increases cultivation gain rate$(li)$(l)Soul Capture Pill$(): Divine sense enhancement$(li)$(l)Lifespan Pill$(): Extends lifespan$(br2)These pills are extremely valuable cultivation resources.

pages.title: Alchemy Skill
pages.text: Alchemy skill improves through practice:$(li)Each successful alchemy grants skill experience$(li)Higher skill = higher success rate and quality$(li)Learning $(l)Alchemy Manuals$() provides bonuses$(li)Joining sects like $(l)Yellow Maple Valley$() unlocks recipe inheritance$(br2)High-level alchemists can craft rare pills, becoming highly sought after.

pages.title: Recipe Acquisition
pages.text: Recipe sources:$(li)$(l)Sect Inheritance$(): Learn exclusive recipes after joining$(li)$(l)Quest Rewards$(): Obtain recipe scrolls from quests$(li)$(l)Market Purchase$(): Buy from NPC merchants$(li)$(l)Secret Realm Exploration$(): Ancient recipes hidden in realms$(li)$(l)JEI Viewing$(): Optional JEI mod shows all registered recipes$(br2)Collecting recipes is an important alchemist goal.

pages.title: Alchemy Economy
pages.text: Alchemy is a major income source:$(li)Craft and sell pills to players or NPCs$(li)Accept sect or faction pill orders$(li)Provide pill supplies for realm exploration teams$(li)Establish your own alchemy market$(br2)High-quality pills can be traded for large amounts of spirit stones, manuals, or rare materials.$(br2)See $(l)Economy Tiers$() and $(l)Market System$().
